coefficient_scope: Default: running maximum of measured 3x3 |error| r^2 through the requested time, with 10% margin, to avoid relying on isolated finite-patch cancellations. Pointwise values are retained as a sensitivity. Other sizes and the experimental NISQ ordering remain transfers. No extrapolation beyond measured time nodes. L=2 uses its own measured 2x2 data. The coefficient also covers measured errors at r=ceil(8 tau) and twice that value, avoiding an uncontrolled leading-order approximation at loose precision.
search_scope: Best over the declared error-allocation grid and shared source menu, followed by integer-step neighbors. Not a global optimizer or a calibrated source-quality tradeoff.
residual_bias_scope: Post-mitigation residual bias reserve, including mismatch and unmodeled SPAM; affordability is assumed, not measured. PEC still assumes the declared invertible channels.
